description: This file implements a PHP class 'redmine' that provides methods to interact with the Redmine REST API, including retrieving issues, projects, statuses, and managing issue creation and updates. It appears to be a utility for integrating Redmine functionality into another system, specifically tailored for use with TestLink, as suggested by comments and naming.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A PHP class for interacting with the Redmine REST API, providing methods to fetch issues, projects, statuses, users, and to create/update issues.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the redmine object with URL, API key, and optional configuration including proxy settings.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Sets up cURL with default options and proxy configuration if provided.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific issue by its ID.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Retrieves all issues, possibly filtered if filters are provided.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Creates a new issue from an XML object, with optional reporter.

methods.name: addIssueFromXMLString
methods.description: Creates a new issue from an XML string, with optional reporter.

methods.name: addIssueNoteFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Updates an existing issue with a note from an XML object.

methods.name: getProjectByIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves a specific project by its identifier.

methods.name: getIssueStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves the list of issue statuses.

methods.name: checkUserExistence
methods.description: Checks if a user exists in Redmine given their login name.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Internal method to perform GET requests to the API.

methods.name: _request_xml
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request expecting an XML response, parsing it into a SimpleXML object if applicable.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified method and parameters, returning response content and metadata.
